data.name: Malign Eye
data.description: As a standard action, you can afflict one target within 30 feet with your malign eye, causing it to take a -2 penalty on all saving throws against your spells. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target hits you with an attack. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|DomainLuckTimes
